item.title: Kinley Jones named MVP of Southern Kentucky All-Star Game
item.description: Grayson County’s Kinley Jones was named the MVP of the Southern Kentucky Middle School All Star Games this past Saturday. Jones helped lead the East squad to a 45-39 win in overtime at Bowling Green High School.
